Alɩf, Lɑɑm, Mɩɩm.
B tõogɑ Rʋʋm rãmba.
Tẽng sẽn pẽ yɑmbẽ ne bεεbã tẽngã (Fɑɑrɩs), lɑ b sẽn tõog-ba poorẽ b nɑ n tõogɑme.
Yʋʋm ɑ wãn poor bɑlɑ. Yellã tɑoor lɑ ɑ poor yɑɑ Wẽnd soolem, lɑ bɑrɑɑre sɩd-kõtbã nɑ n kɩdmɑme.
Ne Wẽnd sõngrã. A sõngdɑ A sẽn dɑt rãmbɑ, lɑ Yẽ lɑ wilb lɑ Welg-n-yols Naaba.
Wẽnd pʋlengo, Wẽnd kɑ yidgd A pʋleng ye. La nebã wʋsgã fãɑ kɑ mi ye.
B mii dũni vɩɩmã yel-vẽenese, lɑ yɑoolem raarã yɛlã, b yaa zɩtb ne rẽ.
Bãmb kɑ tɑgs n ges b mensã pʋsẽ lɑ? Lɑ Wẽnd kɑ nɑɑn sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã lɑ sẽn be b yiibã sʋkã rẽndɑ ne sɩdɑ lɑ wɑkɑt sẽn yãk toɑɑgɑ, lɑ ad nebã wʋsg ka tẽed b Soɑbã sεgbã ye.

Rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ kẽn Tẽngã pʋgẽ n ges rãeenem rãmbã bɑɑsg sẽn n yɩ to-to lɑ? B pãng yɩɩgɑ bãmbɑ; b koo Tẽn-gãngã lɑ b me-ɑ n yɩɩd bãmb sẽn me-ɑ wã. B tẽn-tʋʋmbã waa b nengẽ ne vẽenem-dãmbã, lɑ Wẽnd kɑ yɩ n nɑ n wẽg-b ye, bãmb n dɑ yɩ n wẽgd b mense.
Rẽ poorẽ, neb nins sẽn tʋm wẽngã bɑɑsg yɩɩ wẽngɑ, b sẽn yɑgs Tõnd Aayayã lɑ b sẽn dɑ yɑɑnd-ba yĩngɑ.
Wẽnd n sɩngd naoonegã, rẽ poorẽ n lebs n yɩlm-ɑ, rẽ poorẽ yɑɑ Yẽ nengẽ lɑ y nɑ n lebe.
Lɑ raɑr ning Dũni wã sẽn nɑ n yikã yel-wẽn-mɑɑndbã nɑ n wãaga b tẽebo.
Lɑ sugsdb kɑ nɑ n zĩnd b lɑgem-n-tɑɑsã pʋgẽ b yĩng ye; b na n yɩɩme n kɩfl ne b lɑgm-n-tɑɑsã.
Lɑ dũni wã yikr rɑɑre, b nɑ n weelɑ tɑɑbɑ:
Lɑ sã n yɑɑ ne neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd lɑ b tʋm tʋʋm-sõmã wã, bãmbã bee arzãn bãoogẽ wã n noogd b sũyã.
Lɑ sã n yɑɑ ne neb nins sẽn kɩfl la b yagsd Tõnd Aaya-rãmbã lɑ yɑoolem sɛgbã, bãmb lɑ sẽn na n zĩnd naongã pʋgẽ wã.
Rẽnd bɩ y yɩlg Wẽnd yʋʋrã yãmb sẽn wɑt n kẽed zɑɑbr lɑ y sẽn wɑt n vẽegd beoogo.
A tara Pẽgr sɑɑsẽ lɑ Tẽngẽ, lɑ y sẽn wɑt n kẽed zaabr (Lɑɑnsre) la wĩnto-sʋkɑ (Zɑfɑr) wɑkɑt.
َA yiisdɑ vɩt kiid pʋgẽ lɑ A yiisd kiid vɩt pʋgẽ lɑ A vʋʋgd Tẽngã ɑ sẽn ki poorẽ, lɑ yɑɑ boto me lɑ B nɑ n yiis yãmbɑ.
Lɑ sẽn yi A yel-soalmã pʋgẽ, yɑɑ A sẽn nɑɑn yãmb n yi tãndẽ, rẽ poorẽ tɩ yãmb yɑɑ neb n sãeegdẽ.

Lɑ sẽn yi A yel-soɑlmã pʋgẽ, yɑɑ A sẽn nɑɑn pɑgb yãmb yĩng tɩ yi yãmb mensã pʋsẽ bʋɩl yĩng tɩ y na pɑɑm yɑm-gãɑg b kɩrengã, lɑ A ning nonglem lɑ yolsg yãmb sʋkɑ, ad woto pʋgẽ yel-soɑlem bee sẽn tɑgsdbã yĩngɑ.
Sɑɑsã lɑ Tẽngã naanegã lɑ yãmb zεlmã wã lɑ yãmb kõbgã yõs-tɑɑbã yii A yel-soɑlmã pʋgẽ, ad wãnde pʋgẽ yel-soɑlem bee bãngdbã yĩngɑ.
Lɑ yãmb gõeemã yʋngã lɑ wĩndgã lɑ yãmb sẽn baood A yɩɩdlemã, ɑd wãnde pʋgẽ yel-soɑlem bee sẽn kelgdbã yĩngɑ.

Lɑ sẽn yi A yel-soɑlmã pʋgẽ yɑɑ A sẽn wilgd yãmb tɩ y yãt sɑ-yãgrã tɩ yɑɑ yεεsg lɑ sɑ-koom tẽebo, lɑ A sikd koom tɩ yi sɑɑgẽ wã t'A vʋʋgd Tẽn-gãngã ne-ɑ a sẽn ki poore, ad wãnde pʋgẽ wã, sɩdɑ yel-soɑlem bee sẽn tɑgsdbã yĩngɑ.
Lɑ sẽn yi A yel-soɑlmã pʋgẽ yɑɑ sɑɑsã ne Tẽngã sẽn yɑls ne A sɑgellã, rẽ poorẽ t'A sã n bool yãmb bool-vuk Tẽn-gãongẽ wã lɑ yãmb sẽn tɑr yiib bɑlɑ.
Lɑ sẽn n be sɑɑsẽ lɑ Tẽngẽ yɑɑ Yẽ soolem, b fãɑ yɑɑ sɑk-n-tũ-rãmb A yĩngɑ.
Lɑ Yẽndɑ n sɩngd naoonego, n nɑ n le yɩlem-ɑ rẽ poorẽ, lɑ rẽ n yɩɩd nɑɑnɑ ne-A, lɑ bilgr sẽn yɩɩd zɩslem sɑɑsẽ lɑ Tẽngẽ yɑɑ Yẽ soolem, lɑ Yẽ lɑ Zɩsg n yaa Bʋʋd-Mitɑ.

A rɩkɑ bilgr sẽn yi yãmb mensẽ wã: rẽ yĩngɑ yãmb nusã sẽn so b rãmbã (yembsã) pʋgẽ, yãmb tɑrɑ sood-n-tɑɑs Tõnd sẽn dɩlg yãmbã pʋgẽ tɩ yãmb fãa zem tɑɑb ɑ pʋgẽ, tɩ yãmb zoet-b wɑlɑ yãmb ɑ burkĩnbã sẽn zoet tɑɑbã? Yɑɑ woto lɑ Tõnd welgd D goɑmã sẽn tɑr-b yɑm n tɑgsdẽ wã yĩngɑ.
Pa rẽ bal ye, neb nins sẽn wẽg-b mensã pʋgda b yɑmleoog tɩ ka tũ ne bãngr ye, la ãnd n nɑ n kãndg Wẽnd sẽn menes-b rãmbã? Lɑ b pa tar sõngd me ye.

Bɩ f wẽnem f nengã fãa n yals dĩinã n toglg Wẽnd-yembgo, Saobã yard bal baoob yĩnga; Soab ning sẽn yaa tẽeg-tɩrg-soɑbã. Woto yɑɑ yɑlẽ (nɑɑnego) ning Wẽnd sẽn nɑɑn nebã a pʋgẽ wã, Wẽnd naanegã kɑ tɑr tedgr ye, wãnde yaa dĩin sẽn yɑɑ tɩrgɑ, lɑ ad nebã sẽn yɩɩd wʋsg fãɑ kɑ mi ye.
Tɩ y yɑɑ lεbgdb n tʋgd A nengẽ, lɑ y zoɑy-A, lɑ y yɑls Pʋʋsg lɑ y rɑ yɩ lɑgem-n-tɑɑr rãmba,
n gẽdg neb nins sẽn weel-b dĩinã n lebg sulã, tɩ sull fãɑ kɩdemd ne sẽn be a nengẽ wã.
Lɑ keelem sã n pɑɑm nebã b boonda b Soɑbã tɩ b yɑɑ lεbgdb n tʋgd A nengẽ, rẽ poorẽ t'A sã n lemb-b yolsg sẽn yi A nengẽ lɑ sul sẽn be b pʋgẽ wã n mɑɑnd lɑgem-n-tɑɑr ne b Soɑbã.
Bʋɩl yĩng tɩ b kɩfl ne Tõnd sẽn kõ-ba, bɩ y wʋm noog tɩ ket bilf tɩ y bãnge.
Bɩ Tõnd sikɑ daliil n kõ bãmb t'ɑ togsd bãmb tɩ b sẽn dɑ yɩ n mɑɑnd lɑgem-n-tɑɑrã ne bũmb ninsã mɑnegɑme?
Lɑ Tõnd sã n lemb nebã yolsgo, la b sẽn kɩdemd ne-a; lɑ keelem sã n pɑɑm-b tɩ yɑɑ b nus sẽn tʋm yĩng lɑ b sẽn wãagd b tẽebo.
Lɑ rẽ yĩngɑ bãmb kɑ yã tɩ Wẽnd yɑlgdɑ rɩtlã n kõt A sẽn dɑt soɑb lɑ A wẽoogdẽ lɑ? Ad wãnde pʋgẽ yεl-soɑlem n be ne sẽn kõt-b sɩdã yĩngɑ.
Bɩ f kõ rog-pẽt lɑ nimbãan-ned lɑ so-kẽnd ɑ pʋɩɩre, rẽ lɑ sõamɑ ne neb nins sẽn bɑood Wẽnd yel-sõmdã, lɑ bãmbã lɑ tɩlgdbã.
Lɑ yãmb sẽn kõ ''Rɩbaa'' sẽn na yɩl n paam yõod paasg nebã nengẽ, a ka paasd Wẽnd nengẽ ye, lɑ yãmb sẽn kõ Zaka n dɑt Wẽnd yĩngã, bãmbã la b sẽn na n fãoo n kõ-b rãmbã.

Wẽnd n nɑɑn yãmbɑ, rẽ poorẽ n dɩlg yãmba, rẽ poorẽ n kʋʋd yãmba, rẽ poorẽ n nɑ n vʋʋg yãmbɑ; rẽ yĩngɑ bee yãmb soben-rãmbã pʋgẽ sẽn tõe n mɑɑn boto buud bɑɑ fʋɩ bɩ? Yɩlgemd be ne-A, lɑ A le zẽk n gãndg n yi ne b sẽn mɑɑnd lɑgem-n-tɑɑr ne bũmb ninsã.
Sãang pukɑ yɩng Tẽn-gãng zug la Mogrẽ tɩ yɑɑ nebã nus sẽn tʋmã biisi, bʋɩl yĩng lɑ Wẽnd lemb-b b sẽn tʋmã sãnda tɩ sãn-sãnde b nɑ tek n bɑse.
Yeele: kẽn-y tẽmsã pʋsẽ n ges sẽn deng-b yãmb taoorã bɑɑsg yɩɩ wãn-wãnã? B sẽn yɩɩd wʋsg fãɑ yɩɩ lɑgem-n-tɑɑr rãmbɑ.
Bɩ f tees f nengã dĩin tɩrgẽ wã tɑoor tɩ rɑɑr sẽn ka tɑr lεbsdã nɑ n kɑ tɑ ye, bɑrɑɑr lɑ b nɑ n weel tɑɑbɑ.
Neb ning sẽn kɩfla, a kɩflg bee ne-a; lɑ neb nins sẽn tʋm sõama me yɑa b mens lɑ b segend n bĩngdẽ.
Bʋɩl yĩng lɑ A rol neb nins sẽn kõ-b sɩd lɑ b tʋm tʋʋm-sõmsã ne A yɩɩdlemã, ad A kɑ nong sõm-zɩtb ye.

Lɑ sẽn yi A yel-soɑlmã pʋgẽ yɑa ɑ sẽn tʋm sebdã tɩ b yɑɑ sũ-noogdba (ne sa-koom), bʋɩl yĩng tɩ y na lemb A yolsgã, lɑ bʋɩl yĩng tɩ koglsã kẽn ne A sɑgelle, lɑ bʋɩl yĩng tɩ y na bɑo A yɩɩdlemẽ wã, lɑ sãnd-sãnde y nɑ pʋʋs barka.
Sɩdɑ Tõnd tʋmɑ tẽn-tʋʋmb b nebã nengẽ tɑoor tɩ fo nɑ n kɑ wɑ. B wɑa b nengẽ ne vẽenem tɩ Tõnd sɩbg neb nins sẽn tʋmd yel-wẽnɑ; lɑ sɩd-kõɑtbã sõngr yɑɑ tɩlɑe ne Tõndo.

Wẽnd n tʋmd sobdã tɩ b peegd sɑwɑtã t'A sãeegd-b sɑɑsẽ wã wɑlɑ A sẽn dɑte, lɑ A mɑɑn tɩ b lebg sɑwɑd-pεl tɩ fo yẽt sɑ-koomã t'ɑ yit b pʋsẽ. A sã n sik-ɑ A sẽn dɑt-b rãmb A yembsã zugu, lɑ bãmb sẽn noogd b sũyã.
Lɑ tɑoor tɩ b nɑ n kɑ sik-ɑ n kõ-ba, b ra yɩɩme n da wãag b tẽebo.
Bɩ f ges Wẽnd yolsgã vũunã A sẽn vʋʋgd Tẽngã ɑ kũum poorã, ad yaa Yẽnda n vʋʋgd kiidba, la A yɑɑ bũmb fãɑ gill Tõogda.
Lɑ tɩ Tõnd sã n tʋm sobg tɩ b yã-ɑ t'ɑ yɑɑ rõodo, b nɑ kell n pɑ ɑ loogr poorã n kɩfendẽ.
Rẽnd fo kɑ tõe n wʋmsg kũ-rãmb ye, lɑ fo kɑ tõe n wʋmsg wʋms boɑɑl tɩ b sã n gũd n teesdẽ ye.
Lɑ fo kɑ tõe n kãndg zoees n yiis b menengẽ wã ye; fo sẽn tõe n wʋms-b rãmb yaa neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Tõnd goɑmã, bãmbɑ yaa sak-n-tũ rãmbɑ.
Wẽnd lɑ sẽn nɑɑn yãmb ne ko vɑlenga, rẽ poorẽ t'A kõ pãnga vɑlengã loogr poore, rẽ poorẽ t'A kõ komsgo lɑ kʋʋlem pãngã poore. A nɑɑndɑ A sẽn dɑte, lɑ Yẽnda lɑ bãngd lɑ tõog Naaba.
Lɑ raar ning dũni wã sẽn na n wa yikã, yel-wẽn-mɑɑndbã nɑ n wẽendɑme tɩ bãmb kɑ zĩnd rẽndɑ sɑsɑ yεng bɑlɑ, yɑɑ woto lɑ b rɑg n wẽnesd-b dũni wã n yit sɩdã.
Lɑ b sẽn kõ-b rãmb bãngrã lɑ sɩd-kũunã yeel yã: "sɩdɑ ɑd Wẽnd Sebrã pʋgẽ, yãmb pɑɑme hɑl n tãɑg Yikr rɑɑrã, rẽnd Yikr rɑɑrã lɑ woto, lɑ bũmb ning sẽn be yɑɑ tɩ yãmb rɑ yɩɩme n kɑ miẽ ye.
Rẽnd bɑrɑɑrã wẽgdbã pɑdengã kɑ nɑ n tɑll yõod ne-b ye, lɑ b kɑ nɑ n kõ-b sor me tɩ b bao lebgr ye.
La sɩd la hakɩɩka Tõnd rɩka Alkʋrãan-kãngã pʋgẽ bilgr buud toor-toore, la tɩ fo sã n wa ne Aayar n kõ-ba, kɩfr-rãmbã na yeele: "ad yãmb yaa zĩri-be-neb bala".
Yɑɑ woto bɑl lɑ Wẽnd pɑgd sẽn kɑ mi-bã sũy wã.
Bɩ f mɑɑn sʋgri, bɑlɑ Wẽnd pʋlengã yɑa sɩdɑ, lɑ sẽn kɑ mɑɑnd-b bãng-n-wãɑkã rɑ wɑ tus foom tɩ f mɑɑn sũ-yikr ye.
